spans.s: (I)--the son of कृति, and father of Cedi. भा. IX. २४. 2.
--a name of Kavi located at नैष्- थीय. (उशीराग्नि-वा। प्।). Br. II. १२. ३०; वा. २९. २९.

(I)--a sage by तपस्; elder brother of बृहस्पति who had sexual intercourse by force with उशिज's wife when pregnant. Hence बृहस्पति cursed that son to be perpe- tually ignorant (दीर्घतमस्);
1: Br. II. ३२. ९९; III. ७४. ३६-46; M. ४९. १७.
ममता was his wife.
2: M. ४८. ३२; १९६. ११.
A pravara of अङ्गिरस्. [page१-249+ २७]
(II)--a son of अङ्गिरस; hence a branch of अङ्गिरस. वा. ६५. १००, १०६.
--a son of श्वेत; an अवतार of the Lord. वा. २३. २०५.
--Had शिबि, grandson of ययाति for son. A son of महामन; had five queens of राजऋषि families, each of whom bore a son; (four sons, शिबि and others, ब्र्। प्।). भा. I. १२. २०; IX. २
(I)--a sage who went to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for solar eclipse. भा. X. ८२. १३.
(II)--a tribe of which सुयज्ञ was a king. भा.
--a mt. near Mandara hill; people here felt the influence of हिरण्यकशिपु. M. १६३. ८७.
--and thirty-two other devas from the Sumanasa group. वा. १००. ९१-2.
